snippets.snippet_text: "What's unique about Payhip is that each plan has access to the same features as the next. So, Payhip's Free plan has the same exact features as its Pro plan. The only difference is that you'll be paying a 5% or 2% transaction fee (Plus) vs. a 0% transaction fee with Pro."

"Payhip's email marketing is less robust than Sellfy's, but the feature is offered throughout all of its plans (free or not). It allows you to sync mailing lists, and has a ton of useful integrations for doing so."

intake_notes: Third-party blog (theleap.co), November 7, 2024. SNP-001 provides all three Payhip plan fee tiers: Free=5%, Plus=2%, Pro=0%. SNP-002 notes Payhip email marketing is available on all plans but less robust than Sellfy's.
current_vs_historical_ambiguity: November 2024 data; plan tier names or fee rates may have changed by 2026.
